name: Bently Nevada
about:
Bently Nevada operates from Minden, Nevada, as a division of Baker Hughes. The business traces its roots back more than six decades, building a reputation in machinery monitoring and protection.

The company designs and manufactures a comprehensive portfolio of asset performance management solutions. Its product lines include the 3500 Machinery Protection System, Orbit 60 Series, ADAPT Overspeed/ESD protection, SCOUT200 and ADRE portable vibration analyzers, and System 1 software for condition monitoring and analytic insights. Sensor offerings cover acceleration, velocity, proximity, pressure, hydro, and wireless models, with millions of units installed worldwide and thousands of monitoring systems deployed across a global support network.

Bently Nevada serves asset-intensive industries such as oil and gas (including refining, offshore production, petrochemical, LNG, and fertilizer plants), power generation (coal, combined cycle, wind, hydro), mining, discrete manufacturing, food and beverage, steel and metal, pulp and paper, sugar production, and wastewater. Customers rely on its technologies for turbomachinery, compressors, pumps, motors, gearboxes, and heavy industrial equipment.

The company emphasizes its 60-plus years of machinery expertise, a global services network, and the integration of hardware, software, and diagnostic services through its Cordant Devices platform to connect machine health insights with enterprise workflows.
